article_blocks.text: Strain Type: Sativa-dominant hybrid
Genetics: Princess × Super Silver Grail Haze
Breeder: MrSoul / Brothers Grimm Seeds
THC Content: High
CBD Content: Typically low
Terpene Profile: Myrcene , limonene , beta-caryophyllene
Primary Flavors: Tropical fruit, citrus, sweet flowers, incense
Flowering Time (Indoor): 57–63 days
Outdoor Harvest Time: late September to early October
Indoor Yield: High
Outdoor Yield: High to very high
Grow Difficulty: Easy to moderate

Princess Haze is what happens when one of the foundational females behind Cinderella 99 is sent back into a more overtly Haze-oriented direction. Rather than simply extending flowering time and creating a lanky tropical sativa, Brothers Grimm Seeds used a carefully selected Super Silver Grail Haze male to give Princess stronger branches, heavier flowers, exceptional resin coverage, and more psychedelic intensity while keeping the bloom cycle surprisingly short. The resulting plants can smell like tropical fruit, sweet flowers, citrus, and incense, but the line also hides a much stranger side: certain individuals replace the polished fruitiness with sharp, acrid, almost body-odor funk.

That contrast is part of the cultivar’s personality. Some plants develop compact Christmas-tree structures dominated by a large central cola, while others branch into broader multi-headed bushes. Both can produce thick, intensely frosted flowers, and both deliver a fast cerebral experience that Brothers Grimm has historically described as immediate, spiritual, tingly, and psychedelic. For growers who appreciate classic Haze character but do not want to wait twelve or more weeks for flowers to mature, this is one of the more unusual shortcuts into that style of cannabis.
Genetics and Lineage

The original Princess Haze was created by pollinating Princess with a Super Silver Grail Haze male. Princess is one of the most historically important plants in the Brothers Grimm breeding program because she became the mother of Cinderella 99. She originated from a seed found in Jack Herer flower obtained in Amsterdam and was selected for her unusually strong combination of resin, tropical aroma, compact structure, cerebral potency, and fast maturation. Much of the later Cinderella family can be traced back to MrSoul’s effort to preserve and reproduce those qualities.

Super Silver Grail Haze adds another layer of Cinderella influence along with classic Haze genetics. The male used for the cross came from a keeper Cinderella 99 female known as “The Grail” crossed with a carefully selected Super Silver Haze male. Super Silver Haze itself carries the famous combination of Skunk , Northern Lights , and Haze-associated genetics that helped define late-1990s Dutch cannabis . Through this parent, Princess Haze gained greater branch strength, vigorous growth, incense-like aroma, and a more obvious Haze-oriented cerebral experience.

The pedigree therefore recombines genetics that are related without simply recreating Cinderella 99. Princess contributes the original maternal foundation, while the Super Silver Grail Haze father introduces C99 back through a different branch alongside Super Silver Haze. The outcome is more sativa-leaning and Haze-like than ordinary Cinderella 99, but still significantly faster and more compact than many traditional Haze cultivars. Brothers Grimm also later produced feminized Princess Haze material, but the historic regular version remains the reference point for understanding the strain’s original lineage.
Effects and Experience

The high tends to announce itself immediately rather than creeping upward gradually. A pronounced cerebral shift can arrive almost as soon as the first inhalation settles, bringing heightened sensory awareness, a light pressure or tingling sensation, and a rapid elevation in mood. Colors, music, conversation, and visual surroundings may feel more vivid, and the mind can move into a dreamy but energetic space that retains more momentum than sedation.

At moderate amounts, this character can work particularly well with creative activities, social situations, music, outdoor exploration, or any setting where mental stimulation is welcome. There may be enough physical relaxation to soften tension, but the body usually remains secondary to the headspace. The Haze ancestry becomes especially apparent in the expansive, almost psychedelic quality of the experience, while the Princess and Cinderella side keeps the effect from feeling as drawn out or physically thin as some old tropical sativas.

Potency should not be underestimated simply because the effects are energetic. Brothers Grimm describes the cultivar as extremely potent, and high doses can become mentally demanding. Too much may lead to racing thoughts, difficulty concentrating, dizziness, dry mouth, dry eyes, or temporary anxiety in THC-sensitive consumers. Smaller servings are generally better for preserving the strain’s enjoyable combination of euphoria, tingling energy, and creative mental expansion.
Medical Benefits

Princess Haze may be of interest to medical cannabis consumers who prefer daytime-oriented marijuana that does not immediately create pronounced physical heaviness. The uplifting cerebral phase may help some individuals feel less burdened by low motivation, fatigue, or stress, while the sensory engagement can make routine tasks or creative activities easier to approach. Because the experience can be highly stimulating, however, it may be less suitable for people whose anxiety becomes worse with strong THC or fast-moving cerebral effects.

A gentle physical component develops underneath the mental high and may make mild discomfort or muscular tension feel less prominent without automatically encouraging sleep. This can make the cultivar more practical during periods when remaining active matters. Some consumers may also experience appetite stimulation as the session progresses, while the later stages can become calmer without usually turning into the deep sedation associated with heavy Afghani -derived cultivars.

Current Brothers Grimm descriptions of feminized Princess Haze identify myrcene, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene among the dominant terpenes. Myrcene contributes musky fruit and herbal depth, limonene supports the bright citrus side, and caryophyllene adds peppery warmth and interacts with CB2 cannabinoid receptors. Those compounds help shape aroma and the overall cannabis experience, but they should not be treated as proven treatments for individual conditions. The actual cannabinoid and terpene analysis of a specific harvest, personal tolerance, medications, and dose remain more important than the strain name itself.
Flavor Profile and Aroma

Princess Haze has two noticeably different aromatic directions. The sweeter phenotype leans toward tropical fruit, citrus, flowers, and classic Haze incense. Pineapple-like sweetness, ripe fruit, lemon peel, and floral perfume can rise above a dry herbal base, giving the flower a bright aromatic quality that reflects both Princess and Cinderella ancestry. Incense and spice arrive underneath, providing the unmistakable suggestion of Super Silver Haze.

The second expression is considerably less polite. Brothers Grimm has long noted that some plants become acrid, funky, and almost reminiscent of strong body odor. These phenotypes replace much of the clean tropical sweetness with musk, earth, sharp herbs, and a penetrating fermented character. For some growers, those strange individuals are the most interesting because their aroma is difficult to confuse with the increasingly common candy-and-gas profile of modern marijuana.

Flavor usually follows whichever aromatic direction a plant has chosen. Sweet examples can begin with citrus and tropical fruit before shifting toward flowers, herbs, and Haze spice on the exhale. Funkier phenotypes are earthier and muskier, with acrid notes lingering after the smoke. Vaporization tends to expose more of the fruit and floral detail, while combustion emphasizes incense, spice, and pungency. A slow, controlled cure is especially valuable because much of the strain’s distinction comes from volatile top notes that disappear quickly when flowers are overdried.
Growing Information

Princess Haze grows with a hybrid structure rather than the extreme height and loose branching often expected from a Haze-heavy marijuana strain . Brothers Grimm describes two main expressions. Roughly two-thirds of plants tend toward a single-cola Christmas-tree shape, while the remainder develop into broader, multi-headed bushes. Both forms are capable of heavy flower production, and the compact stature makes the line considerably easier to accommodate indoors than many long-flowering sativas.

Indoor flowering generally requires only about 57–63 days under current breeder guidance. That speed is remarkable considering the obvious Haze influence. The buds become unusually dense and resinous, with trichomes spreading across both flowers and surrounding leaves until mature plants can appear almost furry. A central stake is useful for the single-cola phenotype, while additional branch support should be added wherever flowers begin pulling limbs downward.

Growers who want a broader canopy can top plants early or use low-stress training, particularly when working with the bushier phenotype. A trellis can distribute productive branches and help prevent heavily loaded stems from folding during late bloom. More naturally structured plants can also perform well with only lower-branch pruning, allowing the cultivar’s strong central growth pattern to remain intact. The line is not considered especially fussy, making it approachable for intermediate growers and manageable for attentive beginners.

Production is another major strength. Historical breeder material has placed indoor harvests around six to eight dry ounces per properly developed plant, with outdoor plants capable of considerably more. Those figures should be treated as examples rather than guaranteed yields because plant size, container volume, vegetative time, lighting, nutrition, and environment dramatically affect final weight. What is consistent is the density of the flowers and the cultivar’s ability to carry substantial resin across a surprisingly productive canopy.

Outdoors, vigorous roots and unrestricted light can turn the plant into a much larger producer. The relatively short flowering window can allow maturity around late September to early October in favorable Northern Hemisphere gardens, although latitude and local photoperiod influence the actual date. That early finish is particularly valuable for growers who want Haze-influenced cannabis without pushing deeply into cold or rainy autumn weather .

Dense flowers require attention as harvest approaches. Maintaining airflow through the interior canopy, supporting heavy branches, and avoiding prolonged moisture are particularly important outdoors. The abundant trichome coverage also makes mature flower and sugar leaf attractive material for dry sift, bubble hash, or rosin. Phenotype selection is especially rewarding because growers can choose between sweet tropical-floral plants and much funkier expressions without sacrificing the cultivar’s defining resin and potency.
FAQ
What strains make Princess Haze?

The original Brothers Grimm Princess Haze is Princess crossed with a Super Silver Grail Haze male. That male came from a keeper Cinderella 99 female called “The Grail” crossed with a selected Super Silver Haze male. Princess is also the original mother of Cinderella 99, giving the strain unusually deep connections to the Brothers Grimm C99 family.
Is Princess Haze sativa or indica?

Princess Haze is a sativa-dominant hybrid. Its cerebral effects, tropical and incense-like aromas, and Haze ancestry strongly favor the sativa side, but the plants remain more compact and faster flowering than many traditional sativas. This balance is one of the cultivar’s most useful characteristics.
What does Princess Haze taste like?

Sweet phenotypes can taste of tropical fruit, citrus, flowers, herbs, and classic Haze incense. Other plants are dramatically funkier, producing acrid, musky, earthy aromas sometimes compared with strong body odor. Both expressions are documented characteristics of the original line.
How long does Princess Haze take to flower?

Brothers Grimm currently lists approximately 57–63 days of indoor flowering for the original regular seed line. That short cycle is especially notable for a cultivar with substantial Haze influence. Outdoors, plants can generally finish around late September or early October in suitable Northern Hemisphere climates.
How strong is Princess Haze?

Brothers Grimm describes the cultivar as extremely potent but does not publish a single standardized THC percentage for the original seed line. The high is known for arriving quickly and producing a strong cerebral, psychedelic, and tingly experience. Individual potency will vary according to phenotype, cultivation, harvest timing, and laboratory testing.
Final Thoughts on Princess Haze

Princess Haze is more interesting than its name initially suggests because its pedigree loops through some of the most important material in Brothers Grimm history. Princess, the mother that helped give rise to Cinderella 99, is combined with a Super Silver Grail Haze male carrying both Cinderella 99 and Super Silver Haze. Rather than merely repeating C99, the breeding pushes those familiar genetics into a more overtly Haze-oriented direction.

The results retain a surprising amount of practicality. Flowers can mature in only 57–63 days, plants remain more compact than traditional Haze varieties , yields are substantial, and trichome production can become extreme. Support is often necessary because the dense buds gain significant weight despite the relatively short cycle.

Its aroma also gives growers a reason to explore multiple seeds. Tropical fruit, flowers, citrus, and incense dominate one side of the population, while another group produces acrid, musky funk that can seem almost unrelated. That variation turns a seed run into genuine phenotype hunting rather than simply searching for minor differences between nearly identical plants.

For consumers, the defining feature is the immediate cerebral character: euphoric, sensory, energetic, tingly, and potentially psychedelic at stronger doses. For growers, the attraction is getting that kind of Haze experience without surrendering months of extra flowering time or accepting loose, low-density buds. Princess Haze succeeds because it combines the personality of classic sativa cannabis with the speed, resin, and production that made the Cinderella family famous in the first place.
